method_notes: LBBD community infant/primary admission criteria (Starting school full-time 2026 booklet p23, Priority 3 and note 5; same in Admission Arrangements 2026-27 for Infant and Primary Schools): children who live closest to the school, measured in kilometres in a straight line (as the crow flies) using Synergy's GIS, from the centre of the child's home to the school's main gate; some addresses with different entry points use LLPG designated coordinates. Equal distances (e.g. flats) broken by lottery (random allocation). Priorities: EHCP named, looked-after, sibling (incl. linked infant/junior pairs), distance. Academies Eastbury Primary, Greatfields, James Cambell, Goresbrook, Sydney Russell, free school Riverside and George Carey CofE use the same criteria. Catholic schools (note 12) and St Margaret's CofE also measure straight line from centre of home to main gate for tie-breaks; Thames View Infants uses its own criteria. The statistics table states distances are in km, straight line.

gaps: 2026 figures come from the 'Starting school full-time 2027' e-booklet (p33), downloaded by hand; its URL is assumed, not checked. 2023 figures were not obtained, which no longer matters now 2026 is in. Roding Primary's Hewett Road site is absent from the 2026 table and the 2027 booklet, so it is treated as closed. 2026: '-' in Last place recorded as all_offered, although Sydney Russell's sibling+distance offers (76) exceed its admission number (60) and Robert Clack's exactly fill it, so these may have had an unpublished cut-off. PANs updated to the 2027 booklet directory (Roding Cannington cut from 90 to 30). Data quality: both tables are headed '2024 Criteria' although the text says Sept 2025 / Sept 2024 entry; the 'Distance' count column is identical in both years for every school, and several last-place values repeat exactly (Becontree 0.900, Dorothy Barley 1.729), so the 2025 table may be partly copied from 2024 - values transcribed as printed. '-' in Last place recorded as all_offered (interpretation; some rows have sibling+distance counts above PAN). Greatfields row blank -> not_published. Six faith schools say 'contact school direct' -> not_published. Sydney Russell 2024 printed as 1.4781. PAN taken from the 2026 booklet school list (Sept 2026 entry); the stats tables differ for some (e.g. Riverside 90, Goresbrook 60, Parsloes 60, Valence St Georges 30/60). Split sites (Manor, Ripple, Roding, Valence) listed separately as in the council table; Manor 'Sandringham Infants only' mapped to the Sandringham Road site. Roding Hewett Road site may be closing (consultation 2025). Junior schools (Dorothy Barley Jr, Manor Jr, Thames View Jr, Warren Jr, William Ford CofE Jr) excluded. Postcodes and types checked against GIAS (29 Oct 2026 extract); Rush Green corrected to GIAS RM7 0RL (booklet RM7 0TL); Robert Clack (RM8 1FL) and Sydney Russell (RM9 5QA) use the booklet primary-phase site postcodes rather than GIAS main-site postcodes; split-site second-site postcodes from booklet only. GIAS lists Goresbrook and Greatfields as free schools. Thames View Infants' own measuring method not checked.
